added.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Long Outer
added.description: Crisp white hand-drawn batik against black lace panels, finished with fine floral embroidery. Full length, open front.

added.name: Navy Classic Batik Long Outer
added.description: Navy and sky-blue batik florals in a relaxed long cut with 3/4 sleeves — an easy layer over trousers or a slip dress.

added.name: Maroon Classic Batik Long Outer
added.description: Deep maroon with a classic parang running the length of the front panels. Ceremony-ready, quietly bold.

added.name: Beige Elegance Batik Long Outer
added.description: Soft beige silk crepe with a modern, open batik composition in antique gold. Light enough for every day.

added.name: Black Gold Batik Long Outer
added.description: Antique-gold florals on deep black silk. Open front and short sleeves for a relaxed but striking layer.

added.name: Blush Floral Batik Long Outer
added.description: Blush-pink silk scattered with small cream florals. A soft, romantic long outer for daytime celebrations.

added.name: Olive Heritage Batik Long Outer
added.description: Olive cotton drawn with the four-petalled kawung — a heritage motif in an easy, modern length.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-zenith.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Zenith
silk-monochrome-batik-gown-zenith.description: Our signature silhouette: a fitted cream silk bodice drawn with black batik florals, a contrasting black lapel and a full A-line skirt that falls to the floor.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-kirana.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Kirana
silk-monochrome-batik-gown-kirana.description: A wrap-front gown with a tie belt and bold black florals that grow larger towards the hem. Light silk, generous drape.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-nadira.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Nadira
silk-monochrome-batik-gown-nadira.description: Hijab-friendly and fully lined, with a black obi-style sash and fine floral batik across the bodice and long skirt.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-sasmita.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Sasmita
silk-monochrome-batik-gown-sasmita.description: A modern column gown: a solid black centre panel flanked by cream silk drawn with an abstract floral batik.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-parang-elegan.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Parang Elegance

images.alt: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Parang Elegance
Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Parang Elegance
Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Parang Elegance

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-parang-elegan.description: Diagonal parang bands sweep across the skirt while the bodice keeps a quiet floral ground — a formal gown with movement.

silk-monochrome-batik-gown-apsari.name: Silk Monochrome Batik Gown Apsari
silk-monochrome-batik-gown-apsari.description: Layered mega mendung clouds in black over cream silk, with a belted waist and a softly flared, floor-length skirt. Modest, hijab-friendly cut.

lace-batik-gown.name: Lace Batik Gown
lace-batik-gown.description: A luxurious black lace bodice over a flowing batik silk skirt in black, brown and cream. The V-neckline, sleeveless cut and embellished waist create a refined, feminine look.

silk-batik-dress.name: Silk Batik Dress
silk-batik-dress.description: A beautiful Indonesian batik border motif in warm gold, cream and cobalt blue. The flowing A-line silhouette and 3/4 sleeves suit formal gatherings, cultural occasions and festive events.

gold-foil-batik-silk-dress.name: Gold Foil Batik Silk Dress
gold-foil-batik-silk-dress.description: Black silk with a bold gold batik floral and intricate heritage detailing along the hem. Flowing bell sleeves and a relaxed silhouette for formal and special occasions.

gold-foil-batik-cotton-dress.name: Gold Foil Batik Cotton Dress
gold-foil-batik-cotton-dress.description: Batik cotton in deep black, warm amber and blue, with a round neckline, front button closure and relaxed long sleeves. Breathable cotton perada for all-day comfort, formal or everyday.

batik-silk-dress-set-with-outer.name: Batik Silk Dress Set with Outer

images.alt: Batik Silk Dress Set with Outer
Batik Silk Dress Set with Outer
Batik Silk Dress Set with Outer

batik-silk-dress-set-with-outer.description: A two-piece set: a sleeveless inner dress with a soft grey batik floral and lace trim at the hem, and a long black outer with embroidered florals and pearl-trimmed edges.

silk-batik-dress-2.name: Silk Batik Dress 02
silk-batik-dress-2.description: A solid black overlay over a warm mustard batik silk maxi dress with a vibrant floral in red, navy and green. The cape-style top carries an appliqué flower for a bold, artistic touch.

silk-batik-blouse.name: Silk Batik Blouse 01
silk-batik-blouse.description: Luxurious silk in a soft cream tone with rich brown and navy batik accents. The relaxed batwing silhouette and asymmetric draped hem suit casual and formal occasions alike.

silk-batik-blouse-2.name: Silk Batik Blouse 02
silk-batik-blouse-2.description: A rich olive parang motif against a contrasting cream panel of Javanese-inspired batik in brown and blue. The asymmetric hemline and relaxed 3/4 sleeves give a modern yet culturally rich character.

blouse-stripe-encim.name: Blouse Stripe Encim
blouse-stripe-encim.description: A collared cotton blouse combining traditional Encim batik with striped fabric accents. Casual yet refined, lightweight and breathable for everyday wear.

blouse-stripe-encim-with-collar.name: Blouse Stripe Encim with Collar
blouse-stripe-encim-with-collar.description: A casual blouse in quality cotton combining traditional batik with modern stripe accents, finished with a delicate lace collar for a feminine touch. All-day comfort and breathability.

one-set-sutra-crep.name: One Set Sutra Crep
one-set-sutra-crep.description: A two-piece set: an outer and a matching batik cloth worn as a wrap skirt. Silk crepe with hand-drawn batik — exclusive, smooth and lightweight, for formal occasions.

one-set-classic-sogan.name: One Set Classic Sogan
one-set-classic-sogan.description: A two-piece set of batik blouse and matching skirt in cotton, with comfortable, elegant batik motifs. Lightweight and breathable for formal and semi-formal occasions.
